title: Smoky Canadian Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole filled with smoky flavors and a crunchy topping.
instructions: Cut the jazzy bread into 1-inch cubes.
In a large skillet, sauté the smoky until fragrant. Add the casserole and cook according to package instructions.
In a separate bowl, mix the canadian with a splash of water to create a paste.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange half of the bread cubes.
Spoon the casserole mixture over the bread, followed by the remaining bread cubes.
Drizzle the canadian paste over the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
